<!--
Report every outcome: wins, losses, ties, failures and exclusions. Negative and inconclusive results are as welcome as positive ones. A single trial is not evidence of an improvement.
Paste `briefbench score` output, not log lines or trial folders: those hold your prompts, answers and diffs. Check the paste for private details, such as local folder paths.
Issues are public: no private prompts, outputs or keys.
-->

## Protocol and versions

<!-- The proposal issue or protocol id; the briefbench version or commit; the skill version and the hash `init` recorded; the worker, rewriter and judge CLIs, models and versions; the dates. -->

## Artifacts

<!-- Links to public artifacts, or "private, not shareable". -->

## Sample and outcomes

<!-- Trials run and decided pairs; wins, losses and ties; failed and excluded trials, and why; the significance verdict. -->

## Deviations and missing measurements

<!-- Any change from the frozen plan, and anything that was not measured. -->

## Resources

<!-- Extra time and tokens as `score` reports them, and the plan usage you saw. -->

## Selection

<!-- Is this your only attempt? If not, how many were there, and what happened to the others? -->

## Access, overlap and independence

<!-- Can others inspect or rerun this? Do the tasks overlap with earlier studies? Did you propose the tested change, are you the maintainer, or are you independent of both? -->
